{{Top|leg}}
'''Armorweave underlay''' was an enhancement that increased the resistance of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against any energy damage that had the potential to impair the wearer's physical capabilities. The Mark I, II, III, IV, and V versions in turn allowed for minor increases in protection.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can be used on all types armor, except for robes.
